notice.subtitle: Mod compatibility and risk notice
notice.compatibility: Many mods created for the original Total War: SHOGUN 2 are not compatible with Total War: SHOGUN 2 Complete Edition.
notice.risks: This application may contain bugs. Using it or installing incompatible mods may cause crashes or prevent the game from starting.
notice.recovery: Steam's "Verify integrity of game files" feature may help restore the game, but recovery is not guaranteed. Back up your saves and important files before using mods.
notice.responsibility: By clicking "I agree," you acknowledge these risks and accept responsibility for using this application and any mods you install.
